subtitles.en: However, the company differed announcement until late January next year, which appears to be driving shares lower, unlike high-necks,
subtitles.zh: 然而，公司将公告推迟到明年1月底，这似乎压低了股价，不像海力士那样，

subtitles.en: which announced, you know, meaningful buyback and dividends.
subtitles.zh: 海力士宣布了有意义的回购和分红。

subtitles.en: Samsung had nothing new to add to beyond what it has already announced.
subtitles.zh: 三星除了已宣布的内容外，没有新东西可补充。

subtitles.en: That said, the company is still indicating 55 to 75 filling one additional shareholder returns for this year.

subtitles.en: We detailed to be announced in late January. So a meaningful catalyst still remains in my view.
subtitles.zh: 我们预计将在1月底公布细节。因此，在我看来，仍有重要的催化剂。

subtitles.en: What about for the miss on the chip business, Sanjeev? Should we be worried about that?
subtitles.zh: Sanjeev，芯片业务不及预期呢？我们应该担心吗？

subtitles.en: I don't think the miss was that significant.
subtitles.zh: 我认为不及预期的程度并不那么显著。

subtitles.en: It was a minor miss and most likely related to Korean one strength.
subtitles.zh: 这是一个小幅未达预期，很可能与韩元走强有关。

subtitles.en: Actually, if you look at the DMN and ASPs, those were in line with expectations.
subtitles.zh: 实际上，如果你看DMN和平均售价，这些都与预期相符。

subtitles.en: So maybe some minor effects related issues were there.
subtitles.zh: 所以可能存在一些与小幅影响相关的问题。

subtitles.en: But overall, I wouldn't call it a big miss. And overall, the company's earnings outlook remains pretty good.
subtitles.zh: 但总体而言，我不会称之为大幅未达预期。而且总体来看，公司的盈利前景仍然相当不错。

subtitles.en: We expect tight memory supply to persist for the next three to five years.
subtitles.zh: 我们预计内存供应紧张将持续未来三到五年。

subtitles.en: Lightly in a through 2030 in our view.
subtitles.zh: 在我们看来，这一趋势可能延续到2030年。

subtitles.en: I got to ask you about CXMT, Sanjeev. It seems like they're narrowing at least the technology gap between the likes of Samsung and SK Heinix here.
subtitles.zh: 桑吉夫，我得问问你关于长鑫存储的情况。看起来他们至少正在缩小与三星和SK海力士之间的技术差距。

subtitles.en: How do you think that changes the game when it comes to DRAN now?
subtitles.zh: 你认为这现在会如何改变DRAM市场的格局？

subtitles.en: So there is no doubt about CXMT being a formidable competitor.
subtitles.zh: 毫无疑问，长鑫存储是一个强大的竞争对手。

subtitles.en: They can only improve going forward. The company's market share has increased from one to two percent range, let's say, in 2021
subtitles.zh: 他们未来只会继续进步。该公司的市场份额已从2021年的1%到2%左右

subtitles.en: to now nine to 10 percent range this year. So we continue to win market share.
subtitles.zh: 增长到今年9%到10%的范围。所以我们继续赢得市场份额。

subtitles.en: And we expect them further market share gains for the company.
subtitles.zh: 我们预计该公司将进一步获得市场份额。

subtitles.en: But right now the demand is so strong that Korean suppliers are more focused on AI server-related opportunity,
subtitles.zh: 但目前需求非常强劲，韩国供应商更专注于AI服务器相关的机会，

subtitles.en: which are more profitable. And the CXMT currently has no qualification with the US data center customers.
subtitles.zh: 这些机会更有利可图。而长鑫存储目前尚未获得美国数据中心客户的认证。

subtitles.en: Also, they have difficulties with regard to procurement of advanced production equipment, especially the lithography tools from ASML.
subtitles.zh: 此外，他们在采购先进生产设备方面面临困难，尤其是ASML的光刻工具。

subtitles.en: So that has significantly impacted their technological progress.
subtitles.zh: 因此这显著影响了他们的技术进展。

subtitles.en: And these hurdles are likely to remain in the near term.
subtitles.zh: 这些障碍短期内可能持续存在。

subtitles.en: So CXMT is trying to come up with some work around this EV tools used in lithography.
subtitles.zh: 因此CXMT正尝试在光刻中使用的EV工具上找到一些变通办法。

subtitles.en: But it will not be easy. Having said that, the company does have plan to expand nearly double this capacity
subtitles.zh: 但这并不容易。话虽如此，该公司确实计划将产能扩大近一倍

subtitles.en: in the next three to four years. So as a result, we expect them to win win share.
subtitles.zh: 在未来三到四年内。因此，我们预计他们将赢得更多份额。

clips.title: CLSA Sanjeev Rana：AI推理带动CPU需求，存储产品全面受益？

subtitles.en: So as a result, we expect them to win win share. Sanjeev, I want to ask you about the risk to the overall memory thesis.
subtitles.zh: 因此，我们预计他们将赢得份额。Sanjeev，我想问你关于整体存储逻辑的风险。

subtitles.en: I'll use in a GPUs versus CPUs as an example in how many people say because of the changes in the technology and demands it's not CPUs more than GPUs.
subtitles.zh: 我以GPU与CPU为例，很多人说由于技术和需求的变化，CPU的需求增长超过GPU。

subtitles.en: The reason I just underscored that point is, are there any, are you watching any specific developments around a technology curve that could actually undermine the overall thesis on memory?
subtitles.zh: 我强调这一点的原因是，你是否在关注任何可能削弱整体存储逻辑的技术曲线发展？

subtitles.en: Yes, your right. CPUs are better for certain kind of workloads, especially in AI inference and agent AI.
subtitles.zh: 是的，你说得对。CPU更适合某些类型的工作负载，尤其是在AI推理和智能体AI中。

subtitles.en: So as a result, the demand for CPUs has exploded in the last one year or so.
subtitles.zh: 因此，过去一年左右CPU的需求爆发式增长。

subtitles.en: GPUs are more suitable for AI training. But the common theme here is that whether CPUs or GPUs, both of them need lots of memory.
subtitles.zh: GPU更适合AI训练。但共同点是，无论是CPU还是GPU，它们都需要大量存储。

subtitles.en: So GPUs need HBM and CPUs need more like a server DRAM, which is also a very high ASP product.
subtitles.zh: GPU需要HBM，而CPU更需要服务器DRAM，这也是一个非常高单价的产品。

subtitles.en: So overall, as long as the AI adoption continues to increase, I think we will have opportunities
subtitles.zh: 总体而言，只要AI采用率持续增长，我认为我们将有机会

subtitles.en: to sell all sort of memory products, whether it's HBMs, server DRAMs or enterprise SSDs in case of data centers.
subtitles.zh: 销售各种存储产品，无论是HBM、服务器DRAM还是数据中心的企业级SSD。

subtitles.en: So this memory, like AI industry is offering a lot of multi-growth opportunity for memory suppliers.
subtitles.zh: 因此，存储就像AI行业一样，为存储供应商提供了许多多元增长机会。

subtitles.en: He really wants to try to keep communication as parsimonious as possible and avoid forward guidance.
subtitles.zh: 他真的想尽量保持沟通尽可能简洁，避免前瞻性指引。

subtitles.en: I think he's been quite clear in that regard. Still, the odds of that December rate hike seem about right.
subtitles.zh: 我认为他在这一点上已经相当明确。不过，12月加息的可能性似乎差不多。

subtitles.en: That is, we're starting from a position where inflation remains stubbornly above target.
subtitles.zh: 也就是说，我们的起点是通胀仍顽固地高于目标水平。

subtitles.en: The economy is showing signs of strength as the Fed reported in its own language.

zh_highlights: 经济正显示出强劲迹象

subtitles.en: The labor market is arguably at full employment, so all indications would suggest the Fed should have a bias to hike.
subtitles.zh: 劳动力市场可以说处于充分就业状态，所以所有迹象都表明美联储应该倾向于加息。

subtitles.en: We saw that also a bit in the form of the two descendants, both dissenting two raised rates a quarter point.
subtitles.zh: 我们也从两位持异议者身上看到了一点，他们都反对并支持加息25个基点。

subtitles.en: So there are obviously our disagreements there, but in general, I think the Fed probably needs to nudge rates up a bit further in order to really cement its credibility around achieving
subtitles.zh: 所以显然存在分歧，但总的来说，我认为美联储可能需要再稍微提高利率，以真正巩固其实现

subtitles.en: over the medium term its inflation target.
subtitles.zh: 中期通胀目标的信誉。

subtitles.en: Larry, David, here's a little bit more meaning what does that look like to you in terms of just a number of increases?
subtitles.zh: Larry，David，这里再多一点意义，就加息次数而言，你觉得那会是什么样子？

subtitles.en: Two to three, does that seem plausible?
subtitles.zh: 两次到三次，这看起来合理吗？

subtitles.en: Yeah, so first I do think it's meeting to meeting, and that's not simply because the Fed is reluctant now to issue the kind of forward guidance it did in the past, but for other reasons as well.
subtitles.zh: 是的，首先我认为是逐次会议决定，这不仅仅是因为美联储现在不愿像过去那样发布前瞻性指引，还有其他原因。

subtitles.en: We have obviously a somewhat soft rate of growth of employment in the economy, and the Fed
subtitles.zh: 显然，经济中就业增长率有些疲软，而美联储
en_highlights: soft rate of growth of employment

subtitles.en: is sort of mindful of that. Although financial conditions have not tightened a lot, they have tightened for some sectors of the economy, housing being one in lower quality credits,
subtitles.zh: 对此有所关注。尽管金融条件没有大幅收紧，但对某些经济部门已经收紧，地产市场是其中之一，还有低质量信贷，

subtitles.en: or obviously feeling a pinch now as we see both all in yields rise in some spread widening take place.
subtitles.zh: 或者说显然现在感受到了压力，因为我们看到总收益率上升，一些利差扩大。

subtitles.en: So the Fed, I think, is going to continue to kind of move from one meeting to the next watching the incoming data.
subtitles.zh: 所以，我认为美联储将继续逐次会议根据最新数据采取行动。
en_highlights: move from one meeting to the next

subtitles.en: December, as I said before, is very likely that we'll see a rate hike at that meeting.
subtitles.zh: 正如我之前所说，12月非常有可能在那次会议上加息。

subtitles.en: Beyond that, I don't think there's much need for the Fed to tighten any further than that.
subtitles.zh: 除此之外，我认为美联储没有必要进一步收紧。
